methodologyNote: NHL winning-record rule: a missed-playoff season scores 1 point only when the team won more games than it lost, where every loss counts: wins > regulation losses + overtime/shootout losses. Ties (through 2003-04) count as neither. Points percentage is not used, since the overtime-loss point puts most teams above .500. Each team's counted seasons are listed with their records in winningRecordNoPlayoffSeasons and checked by `python3 ppi_cities.py --check`. The rule reproduces three of the eight site cards (Flyers, Sharks, Stars); the other five (Wild, Sabres, Maple Leafs, Canucks, Oilers) each show one or two more seasons than the rule finds. Those cards stay pinned and the difference is recorded in winningRecordSiteGap.
